verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's annual-report page states pre-purchase which filing it covers (annual reports) and where (filed automatically 'in all states'), with visibility into due dates and status. No price for the filing service itself appears in the evidence; the only published price ($99/year) is for the separate registered-agent service, so it cannot count toward filing cost. Missing for 10: published pricing for the annual-report filing service (per-filing or per-state fees, including state fees), and a per-state or per-filing-type coverage breakdown beyond the blanket 'all states' claim.
